texte: The project rehabilitates the former Keller administrative building as a place for exhibitions and dining, open to residents and visitors. The intervention rests on the contrast between a façade facing the road, which keeps the existing mosaics, and a façade opening onto the landscape. An inner courtyard, created by an opening in the roof, brings light to the original interior staircase and links the building to its surroundings.
recit: Daylight brought back colours that the shadow had long kept silent. What had always been there no longer seemed worn, simply returned to itself. Here, everything seemed to be nothing more than material and light, held between the walls and the open sky. In places, the outside world shrank to a few glimpses of depth, held within the thickness of the walls. Further on, the remains spoke not only of past work, but of a world that had slowly withdrawn from itself. One stood there as if at the edge of a world at a standstill, suspended above the water, with the mountains as the only horizon.
